# Vendored headers

The API builds without system packages for these two header-only libraries:

| File | Project | Version | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `httplib.h` | [cpp-httplib](https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib) | v0.20.0 | MIT |
| `nlohmann/json.hpp` | [nlohmann/json](https://github.com/nlohmann/json) | v3.11.3 | MIT |

Both retain their upstream license text in the file header. Update the version here when the
headers are refreshed.
